trusted_assumptions: Existing vstd specifications for Layout::pad_to_align, Layout::repeat_packed, Layout::extend_packed, and Layout::size.
rationale: Preserves the helper calls and control flow, mechanically desugaring let-else. The matched zero-sized LayoutError is propagated because its non-exhaustive constructor is inaccessible downstream; no observable behavior changes and no new axioms are introduced.
